business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a three-person electrical contractor', 'a design studio in Austin'.

tools.name: pipeline_status
tools.description: The whole pipeline: follow-ups due (overdue first), every open deal by stage with its id, value, chance and weighted value, the weighted forecast, and what was won or lost lately. Call it first when asked about deals, follow-ups or the forecast.

tools.name: add_deal
tools.description: Save a deal the moment it is mentioned, before you describe it: title, company, contact, value in dollars, stage, expected close date and next follow-up. An existing title (or id) is updated, never duplicated. When a deal’s value grows or shrinks, pass its title and valueChange (e.g. 3400) instead of working out the new total.

id.description: Pass it to change an existing deal.

title.description: The job or opportunity, e.g. "Fernwood Studio lighting retrofit".

valueChange.description: When the value grows or shrinks: the dollars added (or, negative, taken off). The tool works out the new total.

probability.description: Chance to win, 0-100, only when it differs from the stage’s usual chance.

inDays.description: Or: the next follow-up this many days from today.

tools.name: move_deal
tools.description: Move a deal to another stage the moment the person says it moved: lead, qualified, proposal, negotiation, won, or lost (with the reason in note). Won and lost close the deal and clear its follow-up.

title.description: The deal’s title or company, when no id.

tools.name: log_activity
tools.description: Record a call, email, meeting or note on a deal as soon as it is mentioned, in the person’s words. Pass followUpAt or inDays when they name the next touch; a call, email or meeting on a due follow-up clears it. When what happened changes the deal’s value, pass valueChange too.

title.description: The deal’s title or company, when no id.

valueChange.description: When the value grows or shrinks: the dollars added (or, negative, taken off). The tool works out the new total.

inDays.description: Or: the next follow-up this many days from today.

tools.name: schedule_follow_up
tools.description: Set a deal’s next follow-up: a date (followUpAt, YYYY-MM-DD) or a number of days from today (inDays), and what it is for.

title.description: The deal’s title or company, when no id.
